03/09.06.2025:

This anticipatory bail application has have been filed by t praying for grant of anticipatory bail in terms of sections 482 and 484 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, as the petitioner has been allegedly implicated in connection with Narayanpur P.S. Case No. 1672017, registered for the offences punishable under section(s) 420, 467,
468, 471, 120B IPC and Section 47(a) of the Excise Act, pending in the Court of learned ACJM,
Jamtara.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw this application as the petitioner wants to appear before the Court below.
3. Permission, as sought for, is accorded.
4. Accordingly, this application is dismissed as withdrawn.

5. If the petitioner appears before the Court concerned, his case will be considered strictly in compliance of the guidelines laid down in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation & Another, reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51 as well as the observation made in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation & Another reported in (2024) 9 SCC 198.
